title: Binary Search in Sorted Array
statement:
Given a sorted array of N distinct integers and a target value T, return the 0-indexed position of T in the array. If T is not present, return -1.

You must implement binary search (O(log N)); a linear scan will receive partial credit only.
inputFormat:
Line 1: two integers N and T.
Line 2: N space-separated integers in strictly increasing order.
outputFormat: A single integer: the 0-indexed position of T, or -1 if not found.
constraints:
1 <= N <= 10^7
-10^9 <= A[i] <= 10^9
All elements are distinct and in strictly increasing order.
-10^9 <= T <= 10^9

examples.explanation: 6 is not present in the array.
